QuestInfo.name: [Morass] One Last Chance
QuestInfo.0: Jean is badly injured from that last experiment. Talk to Jean in the #bResearch Lab#k to make sure he's okay.
QuestInfo.1: Jean is the Flying Fish?! He says his wounds aren't that bad and insists you look for Arkarium at the #bTower#k. For now, go to #bThat Day in Trueffet#k.
QuestInfo.2: You discovered Arkarium at the #bLeaning Tower#k just as Jean said, but the next experiment was already under way.

default.0: Go straight to #bThat Day in Trueffet#k before any more time is wasted.
